notes:
Context: large fintech offering real-time customer-facing chat + millisecond-risk-scoring pipeline. Current infra: hybrid cloud + private VPCs in NA and EU; in-house model ops but want Redwood for predictable economics and operational fallbacks.

Primary ask: reserved GPU pool across regions with explicit failover headroom and per-AZ minimums. Target SLOs: p50 ~80ms, p95 <=220ms for 2k-token chat calls; throughput baseline 200 RPS steady-state, 1,000 RPS burst. POC objectives: demonstrate sustained throughput, cold-start failover, KV/prefix caching behavior under simulated trading-hour spikes.

Proposed reserved plan (customer draft): reserve 40 large-GPU equivalents (A100-80GB class) split: NA-primary (us-east) 24 GPUs, NA-failover (us-west) 8 GPUs, EU-primary (eu-west) 8 GPUs. Requested headroom: 30% spare capacity to meet failover and resharding windows. Expect autoscaling policy for burst beyond reserve to route to on-demand capacity with >99.5% availability SLA.

Key negotiation items:
- Throughput guarantees: WANT committed tokens/sec per region + measurable throttles. Customer insists on documented profiling for model variants (8-bit quant vs fp16) to map to GPU counts.
- Latency SLOs: demand p95 SLO with credits for breaches; require tracing hooks and token-level latency breakdown.
- Failover: multi-region routing policy with warm KV replication (prefer cross-region warm-cache for top 5 intents). Acceptable RTO for full failover: 90s for degraded mode, 5min for full capacity.
- Headroom accounting: define headroom as reserve * 0.30, with automatic notifications when utilization >65% for 10min.
- AZ distribution: require minimum 2 AZs per region with at least 1 GPU pool per AZ to avoid single-AZ blast radius.

Security/compliance notes: need HSM-backed keys (HSM/KMS) for model encryption at rest, SOC2 report and ISO27001 preferred, audit logs retention 7 years for certain regulated flows, SSO (SAML) integration ok. Data residency: EU tenant must keep customer PII in EU region.

POC metrics & success criteria: p95 latency under SLO for 48h sustained at baseline load; successful failover from us-east -> us-west within 2 minutes while keeping error rate <1%; cost model delivered showing unit cost/token at expected utilization bands (40%, 70%, 95%).

Recent objections / customer redlines: procurement pushing back on long-term commit (12-mo) without flexible regional reassignment clause. Security wants HSM detail and support for customer-managed KMS. Infra asked for a hard number to map model A100-equivalent to our stubbed GPU SKUs — SE action to supply mapping table.

Stubs / links: pricing deck in Drive, MSA draft in Drive, Fireflies 2026-03-02 for capacity workshop. Jira tickets INF-4321 (capacity mapping) and SEC-2108 (KMS/HSM questions) opened.

Short next actions (AE/SE): 1) deliver SKU->A100-equivalent mapping, 2) update reserved pool diagram with explicit AZ placement, 3) legal to reissue MSA with regional reassignment clause, 4) schedule 2hr POC run with simulated trading spikes (target week 2026-04-06).
